review.summary: The research order and restricted estimands are coherent, but Phase 1 is not yet an executable preregistration because its finite population, scorer, missing-context behavior and exact gates are not mechanically frozen.

next_action: Create and test the runtime-source-context-pilot-v1 manifest schema, deterministic atom scorer, context extractor contract, exact gate fixtures and fail-closed preflight verifier; do not launch inference yet.
interpretation: The second review validates the repaired causal scope and sequence but exposes the boundary between a research roadmap and an executable freeze. The required changes are local contract definitions, not a new research direction.
limitations: This is one fresh independent re-review and not an inter-reviewer consensus process.
The reviewer saw only the sanitized plan, prompt and schema, so existing unprovided implementation code was correctly treated as not frozen.
No source items, sealed references or Phase 1 implementation artifacts were reviewed.
